paite: Huchiin Jobin a dawnga, hichiin a chi a:
Tuni mahmahin ka phunna helhuai ahi: ka thuakna ka mauna sangin a gikjaw hi.
english: “Even today my complaint is rebellious. His hand is heavy in spite of my groaning.

paite: Aw amah ka muhna mun thei lengla, a tutna mahmah ah hoh thei leng aw!
english: Oh that I knew where I might find him! That I might come even to his seat!

paite: A maah ka thu ka bawlhoih dia, thugentein ka kam dimsak ding hi veng.
english: I would set my cause in order before him, and fill my mouth with arguments.

paite: A honna dawnna ding thute ka thei dia, huan bang ahia ka kianga a gen ding ka theisiam ding.
english: I would know the words which he would answer me, and understand what he would tell me.

paite: A thilhihtheihna letnain kei a honsel diam? Ii; himahleh kei a honlimsak ding hi.
english: Would he contend with me in the greatness of his power? No, but he would listen to me.

paite: Huailaiah mi dikin amah thu a sutpih thei dia; huchiin ka vaihawmmi akipan suahtaksakin ka om tawntungta ding hi.
english: There the upright might reason with him, so I should be delivered forever from my judge.

paite: Ngaiin, mailam juanin ka paia, himahleh huailaiah a om kei; huan nunglam juanin, himahleh amah ka mu kei hi.
english: “If I go east, he is not there; if west, I can’t find him;

paite: Veilam pangah, na sep laiin, himahleh amah ka mu theikeia: taklam pangah a bu, amah ka muh theihlouhna dingin.
english: He works to the north, but I can’t see him. He turns south, but I can’t catch a glimpse of him.

paite: Hiamhleh ka zuih lampi a thei a; a hon zeet laiin, dangkaeng bangin ka honsuakkhe ding hi.
english: But he knows the way that I take. When he has tried me, I shall come forth like gold.

paite: Ka khein a kalsuante a len kipa; a lampi ka juita, ka pial kei.
english: My foot has held fast to his steps. I have kept his way, and not turned aside.

paite: A mukte thupiak akipan ka pai kik keia, a kama thute a kiphamoh ka an sangin ka kholkhawm jaw hi.
english: I haven’t gone back from the commandment of his lips. I have treasured up the words of his mouth more than my necessary food.

paite: Himahleh amah lungsim khek lou ahia, amah kuan a hei thei dia? a khain a deih, huai mah a hih jel hi.
english: But he stands alone, and who can oppose him? What his soul desires, even that he does.

paite: Kei dia sehsa a hih ngala: huan thil huchibang tampi a kiangah a om hi.
english: For he performs that which is appointed for me. Many such things are with him.

paite: Huaijiakin a omna ah ka buaia; ka ngaihtuah chiangin amah ka lau hi.
english: Therefore I am terrified at his presence. When I consider, I am afraid of him.

paite: Pathianin lah ka lungtang a bahsakta ngala, huan Thilbangkimhihtheiin a honhihbuaita hi.Khomial main satkhiakin ka om ngal keia, ka maia kipan khomial sah leng a khuh sam kei hi.
english: For God has made my heart faint. The Almighty has terrified me.

paite: Khomial main satkhiakin ka om ngal keia, ka maia kipan khomial sah leng a khuh sam kei hi.
english: Because I was not cut off before the darkness, neither did he cover the thick darkness from my face.
